'''Domain Nar''' was a [[Domain]] among the [[Intendant caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. They were rivals with [[Domain Shul]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
